list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] != '' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.cluster AS cluster, instances, statements_per_sec, p95_ms, max_lag_s
FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, uniqExact(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS instances FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up' AND Value = 1 AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE
      GROUP BY cluster) AS c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, round(count() / ($__toTime - $__fromTime), 1) AS statements_per_sec,
                  round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS p95_ms
           FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
           GROUP BY cluster) AS s ON s.cluster = c.cluster
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, round(max(Value), 1) AS max_lag_s FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
           WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_replication_lag' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE
           GROUP BY cluster) AS l ON l.cluster = c.cluster
ORDER BY cluster

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000 AS p95
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time, cluster ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['query_id'] AS query_id, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster,
       substring(any(LogAttributes['db.query.text']), 1, 100) AS statement,
       count() AS calls, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1e6, 1) AS total_s,
       round(100 * sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / sum(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us']))) OVER (PARTITION BY cluster), 1) AS pct_of_cluster,
       round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS p95_ms
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['query_id'] NOT IN ('', '0')
GROUP BY query_id, cluster ORDER BY total_s DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod,
       sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['shared_blks_read'])) / $__interval_s AS blocks
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time, pod ORDER BY time

SELECT time, pod, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY pod ORDER BY time
                ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) / 60 AS cores
FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, max(Value) AS v
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total' AND Attributes['container'] = 'postgres'
        AND Attributes['namespace'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
      GROUP BY time, pod)
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, max(Value) AS backends
FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes, sum(Value) AS Value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
      GROUP BY TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes)
GROUP BY time, pod ORDER BY time
